Frequently Asked Questions

Clear answers to common WooCommerce care plan questions.

What happens if an update breaks my store checkout?+
We test every update on a staging site before touching your live store. If an unexpected conflict occurs on your live site, we instantly roll back to a clean backup within minutes.
How do I use my included monthly developer hours?+
You can use your dedicated hours for small design adjustments, setting up coupons, uploading products, setting up shipping rules, or adding new payment gateways.
Are there long-term contract commitments?+
No long-term contracts! All monthly support plans are billed month-to-month. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your support subscription at any time.
